question: In which of the following years did India celebrate its 73rd Republic Day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2022**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **73rd Republic Day:-**

 
 
• The 73rd Republic Day of India would be celebrated on January 26th, 2022.
 
• The Republic Day of India is a national holiday celebrated each year to honor the day the Constitution of India came into effect, on January 26th, 1950, officially marking India as a republic.
 
• This was a significant moment, as it marked the transition of India from a British colony to an independent republic with a democratic government system.
 
• On this day, a grand parade is conducted in the national capital, New Delhi, at the Rajpath, in front of the President of India.
 
• The Republic Day Parade is a significant event and showcases India's cultural diversity and military might
